title: Simple & rapid genotyping of marine microeukaryotes
author: Jernej Turnšek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jcdcis6

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a PCR master mix for x reactions (where x is the number of strains plus 2), consisting of MQ water, 10 µM forward primer, 10 µM reverse primer, and Phire Plant Direct PCR Master Mix.

steps.title: Aliquot mix and add DNA templates
steps.instruction: Aliquot the master mix into PCR tubes and add 0.5 µL of the strains to be genotyped.

substeps.instruction: Include appropriate positive (if available) and negative controls.
Include the WT or knockout strain used for transformation as a template in one of the reactions.

steps.title: Passage genotype+ strains
steps.instruction: Passage the genotype+ strains into 10 mL of fresh medium.

substeps.instruction: Use a 1:100 or 1:50 dilution as a starting point.
